number_format: Inputs are binary64: 'binary64' is the shortest round-trip decimal, 'hex' the exact hex form, 'exact' the exact rational. Derived reals are decimal strings ('value', 40 significant digits) with the nearest binary64; 'exact' on a derived quantity is an exact rational. Deviations and cross-check residuals are short diagnostics, not references. SI units.
item: Closely spaced pair from a tip spring (general p, q form), and the repeated-pair basis ambiguity (assigner's additions to items 3 and 5)

eb.description: pipe along X, spring along (0,1,1) in plane p, excitation along Y: c_p = c_q = 1/sqrt 2
eb.use: verification and comparison: the spring is perpendicular to the pipe (d.a = 0), so no axial coupling is neglected

rayleigh.description: pipe along X, spring along (0,1,1) in plane p, excitation along Y: c_p = c_q = 1/sqrt 2
rayleigh.use: verification and comparison: the spring is perpendicular to the pipe (d.a = 0), so no axial coupling is neglected

eb.description: pipe along the space diagonal (1,1,1), spring along global X with stiffness k, excitation along global Y: p = (2,-1,-1)/sqrt 6, q = (0,1,-1)/sqrt 2, k_eff = 2k/3, c_p = -1/sqrt 6, c_q = 1/sqrt 2; the coupling of the spring's axial component to axial deformation is neglected (pipe axially rigid)
eb.use: COMPARISON ONLY, NOT FOR VERIFICATION AT THE ANALYTIC TOLERANCE. Case (b) assumes an axially rigid pipe. The neglected coupling of the spring's axial component to axial deformation lowers the first plane-p frequency by about 8.1e-8 relative and changes the plane-p mode 1 contributions by about 1e-7, a hundred times the 1e-9 verification tolerance, and the coupled modes acquire axial components that participate through c_axial. Case (b) is cross-engine comparison data and cannot verify a product model with finite axial stiffness at 1e-9. Case (a) is unaffected.

neglected_axial_coupling.formula: with the pipe's axial tip compliance L/EA, the spring seen by plane p is k d_p^2 (EA/L)/(EA/L + k d_a^2), a relative reduction delta = k d_a^2 (L/EA)/(1 + k d_a^2 L/EA); its first-order effect on a plane-p frequency is -delta kappa W(1)^2/(2 Om^2 D)

axial_component_of_excitation.note: c_axial = 1/sqrt 3 excites the axial modes, uncoupled here; their first frequency is far above T1's range, so a benchmark must treat them as rigid (missing-mass correction with f_r below them) or exclude the axial component; they are not in the combinations above

repeated_pair.description: a circular cantilever free in three dimensions: mode 1 is an exactly repeated pair. Any orthonormal basis (e1, e2) of the pair is a valid output; with e1 = (cos t, sin t), e2 = (-sin t, cos t) in (Y, Z) and excitation along Y, mode e1 contributes cos^2 t A to uY and cos t sin t A to uZ, mode e2 contributes sin^2 t A and -sin t cos t A. The scope's 'largest component is +1' normalization does not fix t.

closed_forms.uY SRSS: A sqrt(cos^4 t + sin^4 t): max A at t = 0, min A/sqrt 2 at t = 45 deg
closed_forms.uZ SRSS: A |sin 2t|/sqrt 2: min 0 at t = 0, max A/sqrt 2 at t = 45 deg
closed_forms.adopted reading (cluster summed first, t: uY = A, uZ = 0 for every t and every rule
closed_forms.CQC: rho = 1 for equal frequencies, so CQC = |c1 + c2| = the invariant value for every t
closed_forms.GROUPING, PAIRWISE10, ABSSUM: |c1| + |c2|: uY = A (invariant), uZ = A |sin 2t| (0 to A)

repeated_pair.reading_of_the_rule_fields: In rows, the fields SRSS, CQC, GROUPING, ABSSUM_not_in_scope and PAIRWISE10_not_in_scope (and the closed_forms and extremes entries named after them) apply each rule mode by mode: NOT the adopted reading, published to show the basis dependence. Under the adopted reading (the modes of one numerically repeated cluster, DEL-04-09's delta_c = 2^-20 on eigenvalues, are summed with their signs first and every modal rule is applied to the cluster sums) every rule returns the basis_invariant_sum_first values, uY = A and uZ = 0, at every angle; adopted_cluster_sum_first gives that result per rule for comparison with a product. The invariance of the cluster sum is exact for an exactly repeated eigenvalue and an M-orthogonal basis, as here.

cross_checks.what: plane p roots: determinant route against beta^3(1 + cos cosh) - kappa(cos sinh - sin cosh) = 0
per mode: clamp + spring + inertia = 0 in global components
per mode: clamp moment + L a x F_spring + inertia moments (quadrature of int x W) = 0
under the adopted reading every rule equals the basis-invariant value at every theta, exactly
